product.title: SUP / Kayak Wildlife exploration through mangrove jungle
product.description: Paddle through a mangrove jungle environment on a wildlife-focused SUP or kayak route near Miami. This eco-style outing emphasizes nature, calm water exploration, and local habitat discovery.
highlights: Choose SUP or kayak for mangrove exploration
Look for local wildlife in a natural setting
Great option for outdoor and eco-adventure travelers

meetingPoint.description: Final launch location and arrival guidance are provided in your voucher.

faqs.question: What can I use on this tour?
faqs.answer: You can participate using a stand-up paddleboard or a kayak.
